Class XmlBlindTranscriptionType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlBlindTranscriptionType
public class XmlBlindTranscriptionType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="https://phon.ca/ns/session" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://www.phon.ca/phon-manual/session_editor/blind_transcription.html?hl=blind%2Ctranscription">Phon manual section on this topic...</a>

Java class for blindTranscriptionType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="blindTranscriptionType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <choice>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}u"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}pho"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}tierData"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}pm" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}mors"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}gras"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}unparsed"/>
       </choice>
       <attribute name="transcriber" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}string" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getPm

      public List<XmlPhoneMapType> getPm()
      Gets the value of the pm property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the pm property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getPm().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlPhoneMapType
